en: Colorized historical postcard showing an outdoor concert in a park. In the center is a large wooden bandstand or music pavilion with a pitched roof and an orchestra playing inside. In front, many elegantly dressed people in early-20th‑century clothing stroll, stand, or sit on white chairs arranged in rows under tall trees. At the top of the card is German text printed in red.
